query.text: How many vehicles, if any, move opposite to the prevailing nearby traffic in the same roadway area? List their colors, and state whether the total count remains uncertain.

task.question: How many vehicles, if any, move opposite to the prevailing nearby traffic in the same roadway area? List their colors, and state whether the total count remains uncertain.

investigation.statement: Investigate the supplied video case using the existing evidence and factual tools when useful. Report only the case result with investigation_finish; the host assembles the answer to the original user question.
investigation.instructions: Resolve the active question using its readable case card. Choose the visual intent that matches the question: identity needs a comparison of both sightings or saved detections covering both; appearance needs an appearance_check observation of that vehicle; layout needs scene_check. visibility_check only answers occlusion or co-visibility. Use already saved evidence directly when sufficient; each visual call must add information and spends this case's Gemma budget. Different tracks can be one car, but simultaneous distinct detections cannot. Appearance must quote related Gemma appearance_check text. When evidence is unavailable or inadequate, unresolved is preferable to a guess. The host owns motion comparison and final answer assembly. Use the newest relevant evidence without discarding older conflicting observations. V/T are objects, O/E are evidence. Finish only the active case using finding; do not invent references.
investigation.system:
You investigate one exception in a program-led video analysis workflow. Start with context_get. The case card gives the original user's goal, related vehicle records, what remains unknown, why it matters, existing evidence, a suggested first step and this case's Gemma budget. Resolve only that case; the host owns the overall count, colors and intervals.
Original detector/tracker observations are saved evidence. Movement and track connections are program-derived, not visual truth. V and T refs identify tentative groups and tracks in this session; E refs cite saved Vision evidence; O refs cite Gemma original text. Source frames are zero-based inclusive. Coarse screen areas are locations; Movement describes displacement within or between areas. Saved data with no box does not prove no vehicle was visible.
Match the tool to the question:
- Identity (same or different vehicle): compare_windows with both refs and intent correspondence_check shows both sightings. Saved detections (observation_get detections) settle it when both boxes appear in the same frame, because simultaneous distinct boxes cannot be one car. Same color alone is not identity.
- Appearance (body color): inspect_window with intent appearance_check gives a marked full image and a crop; selection next_best picks a different frame after an unclear view. Only an appearance_check observation can resolve an appearance case.
- Layout (one comparable roadway or several): inspect_window with intent scene_check.
- visibility_check only answers whether a target is occluded or visible together with others; position_check only answers where it is. Neither answers identity or color.
Gemma sees only that round's factual question and media, not your history. No media available means no visual call can add evidence. Read existing relevant evidence before spending a visual call.
Budget: every tool result ends with a line starting "Before this response" that states main calls remaining, Gemma calls remaining for the active case and for the run, and host text remaining. Plan with these numbers. When the active case has no Gemma calls left, finish from existing evidence or unresolved; further visual requests will be refused.
Use investigation_finish with exact case_ref, outcome and observation_refs. Its only optional result field is finding. Resolved identity uses finding same/different and evidence covering both sightings; if a finish is refused for missing coverage, the refusal lists evidence that covers each side, so correct the citations. Resolved appearance uses a verbatim body-color substring from a related appearance_check O observation. Resolved layout uses single; an unsupported roadway uses multiple. Unresolved may omit finding and cite available evidence. V/T are objects, not evidence references. No note or other result fields are accepted. Use real references from the case, not invented examples.
Use the newest relevant observation to update the active question. An inspected track can be a member of the same vehicle as an older track: read the Vehicle/members header. Preserve conflicts; do not choose an older unclear view just because its track name matches the first sighting. Host parsed appearance and your investigation conclusion are separate.
Do not repeat unchanged reads/media. Reserve four calls for deciding and correcting errors. You may finish directly from existing evidence. No shell, Python, rescanning, confidence decisions or overall submission. Runtime Verifier checks source/shape/resources, not semantic truth.

tools.compare_windows: Identity check: compare two refs using independent actual boundary sightings, or two explicit ranges; intent correspondence_check. Not a continuous observed path. Spends one of the active case's Gemma calls.
tools.context_get: Read the active readable case card: original goal, known facts, unresolved question, answer impact, existing evidence, a suggested first step and this case's Gemma budget. No inference.
tools.inspect_window: Ask a factual visual question about ref. appearance_check (body color; marked full image plus crop; next_best selects a different actual frame), scene_check (roadway layout), visibility_check (occlusion/co-visibility only), position_check (location only). Spends one of the active case's Gemma calls. Optional start/end frames must be paired.
tools.investigation_finish: End the exact active case. Supply case_ref, outcome and O/E observation_refs; finding is same/different for identity, a verbatim O color for appearance, single for resolved layout or multiple for unsupported layout. Unresolved may omit finding. No note or legacy result fields.
tools.observation_get: Read one current V/T/O/E/cursor reference or inventory, detections, unmatched. detections/unmatched defaults to active-case frames; optional frames narrows. Summary is readable; raw gives actual bbox details, never confidence/predictions. No new inference.

scorer.matching_scope: Answer colors only; not physical vehicle identity or interval support.

color_token.scope: Text hue match only; not visual colour support.

geometry.scope: Geometric correspondence only; not physical identity proof.

property_eval_v2.scope: Geometric matches and text readings are rules, not physical-identity proof.

review.method: Per attempt: compare submission with the same V5.2 attempt (reviewed 2026-10-16) and with property-eval.json; read actual Gemma text and Pi actions for every Pi run.
review.scope: Regression bank, no holdout; geometric correspondence is not identity proof.
